scenes.title: WHAT IS STRESS?
scenes.subtitle: A one minute check
scenes.narration: Welcome back. Today we look at stress.

scenes.title: DEFINITION
scenes.html:
Stress is force per unit area.

It is measured in pascals.
scenes.narration: [SYNC] Stress is the force acting on each unit of area. [PAUSE:1] [SYNC] We measure it in pascals.

scenes.title: WORKED STEP
scenes.narration: [SYNC] Divide the force by the area and you have the stress.

scenes.title: CHECKPOINT
scenes.question: What is the unit of stress?
scenes.narration: Quick check. What is the unit of stress?
scenes.reveal_narration: It is the pascal. Nicely done.
scenes.explanation: One pascal is one newton per square metre.

scenes.title: WRAP UP
scenes.narration: That is stress in one line.
